summary: CE-3 v1 slice VERIFIED end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 CE-3 acceptance tests pass (test_ce3_v1.py) covering status flag, lifetime-cap shape+bounds ($137,917.01 standard cap, remaining math), years_at_current_pace null-when-new contract, /lifetime-cap/refresh, annual projection FY label + range brackets estimate + persona-aware caregiver/participant_self explanations + band_percent {5/15/30} + confidence {high/medium/low}, reconciliation idempotency (same rec id on repeat), 422 on bad month '2026-XX', months_back=12 list, step_change_variance auto-opens LOOP-1 case with source_tool='ce3', source_artefact_type='contribution_reconciliation', metadata.contribution_variance=true, add-user-note, action=confirmed_correct, cross-household random-UUID 404. Regression: LCA-1 iter112 4/4 green; loop1+core1 31/31 green (total 47/47). /api/health cold path 88-107ms (5 hits) – well under 300ms. Frontend: /app/participants/:id/contribution-position renders ce3-contribution-position-page with all 3 cards (lifetime-cap, annual, reconciliation). Live values for Cathy/Dorothy: 'You've paid $800.00 toward your $137,917 lifetime cap', Remaining $137,117, 'approximately 31 years'. Refresh button POSTs /lifetime-cap/refresh (1 call). Reconcile button POSTs and the new row (ce3-reconcile-row-2026-11) appears in ce3-reconcile-list. ParticipantProfile link (core1-view-contribution-position) verified after a 1-line fix (see below).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. participantId prop was not passed at line 524, so the guard `{participantId && (...)}` around the Link never rendered — the 'See contribution position →' link was completely missing from the profile page. One-line fix: passed participantId={id}. Verified end-to-end after fix.

issues: Estimate shows $0 with 'Range $0 – $0 (±15%)' and 'medium confidence' because no saved CE-2 contribution_estimate exists for this participant yet. The card copy 'Once you save a contribution estimate, we'll show the annual projection here.' is on-message, but showing '$0 · medium confidence' feels contradictory — either drop the confidence pill or downgrade to 'low' when annual_estimate == 0. Cosmetic, not blocking.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) When annual_estimate == 0, the annual card should show 'low confidence' or hide the confidence pill entirely — currently shows 'medium confidence' next to '$0'.

Confirm intended UX for participantId={id} prop pass in FinancialCard — testing agent applied the trivial one-liner so the link would render; main agent may want to sanity-check no other consumer relied on the old signature (grep shows FinancialCard is only called once at line 524).
critical_code_review_comments: Bug: /app/frontend/src/pages/ParticipantProfile.jsx line 524 was missing participantId prop to <FinancialCard/>. Because the link is guarded by `{participantId && (...)}`, it silently disappeared and the whole CE-3 entry point was inaccessible from the UI. Fixed. Would have failed the review_request bullet '...has a See contribution position → link (core1-view-contribution-position) inside the Financial position card that navigates to /app/participants/:id/contribution-position'.

ContributionPosition.jsx cards are well-instrumented with data-testid on every meaningful element (cap headline, remaining, years, progress, reconcile row per month, per-row case link). Excellent testability.

test_ce3_v1.py uses live MongoDB to seed a future-month (2027-03) statement to force step_change_variance, then cleans up statements + reconciliations + case + case_events in a finally block. Good hygiene.
server.py background startup batches (batch2, batch3) still working — verified by /api/health responding <300ms (max 107ms across 5 probes).
Known orthogonal issue (out of scope per main agent, NOT flagged as a new bug): GET /api/statements + GET /api/budget/current return 500 for cathy on the dashboard. Documented since iter101.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after 1-line fix to ParticipantProfile (link, navigation, refresh POST, reconcile POST + row-in-list all verified)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests seed a March-2027 statement (contribution $2000) to force step_change_variance and clean up statements/reconciliations/case/case_events in finally. Frontend test created reconciliations for 2026-08, 2026-09, 2026-11 for pid 0c53... — these persist but are idempotent (same-month POST returns existing id) and low risk.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CE-3 v1 selectors (all stable): ce3-contribution-position-page, ce3-lifetime-cap-card, ce3-lifetime-cap-refresh, ce3-lifetime-cap-headline, ce3-lifetime-cap-remaining, ce3-lifetime-cap-years, ce3-annual-card, ce3-annual-estimate, ce3-annual-range, ce3-annual-confidence, ce3-reconciliation-card, ce3-reconcile-month-picker, ce3-reconcile-btn, ce3-reconcile-list, ce3-reconcile-row-{YYYY-MM}, ce3-reconcile-case-link-{rid}, core1-view-contribution-position. If FinancialCard is refactored, remember to pass participantId — otherwise the CE-3 entry link disappears silently.
rca of the issue: ParticipantProfile.jsx defined FinancialCard with a participantId prop guarding the 'See contribution position →' Link, but the caller at line 524 did NOT pass participantId, so `{participantId && (...)}` evaluated falsy and the link never rendered. Reproduction: log in as cathy, navigate to /app/participants/0c538637-.../ — before fix, no link in Financial position card. Mitigation: pass participantId={id} in the JSX call site. Verified after fix: link visible, click navigates, page renders 3 cards with real data ($800/$137,917, ~31 years).
